title: 第2420章 叶蓁被困第2419章 前往阴阳庙
lines: “被困住了？”夏侯缨惊呼一声。
叶蓁此刻正深入阴阳庙，但这不是第一次了，不谈过去的经历，单单这一次探索千神洞府，叶蓁都已经前后进入阴阳庙五次。
这几次虽说都没能闯过阴阳庙，但自保却已经是驾轻就熟，从未出现意外。
可夏侯葵不会出错。
夏侯缨脸色顿时紧张起来，忍不住担忧。
叶蓁并非好妻子，在外的名声也不好，但对她们姐妹，却是倾尽全部。
“去找老爹！”夏侯缨直接冲了出去。
此刻，阴阳庙之外，夏侯家驻地，正人来人往，来去匆匆。
千神洞府是夏侯家的地盘，夏侯家在这里经营已久，底蕴自然不是其它势力可以相比。
本次探索，夏侯家的目标当然不只是阴阳庙之后的神名核晶，同时，在千神洞府各处，都派遣了强者，将夺取一宗宗造化。
若是一切顺利，那么夏侯家得到的好处将是难以想象的。
其余所有人的总和，估计也就能够与夏侯家相当而已。
夏侯家多点开花，自然压力也不小，此刻夏侯徳坐镇指挥，统筹各方，需要处理的事务极多，也是忙得焦头烂额。
“老爹，老妈被困住了，是怎么回事？”夏侯缨直接闯了进来。
而她的话，让夏侯徳等一众夏侯家的高层，都是一怔。
夏侯徳，坐在当中主座，他国字脸，一脸的威严，是那种大家族刻板印象里的家主模样，坐在那里便是不怒自威。
夏侯徳蹙眉，问道：“缨儿，到底怎么回事，你在说什么？”
即便是夏侯徳，此刻都没有收到叶蓁被困的消息。
“大姐说的，老妈被困住了！”夏侯缨连忙道。
夏侯葵说的。
对此，夏侯家一众强者都是心头一凛。
夏侯葵应该不会出错，那也就是说，叶蓁真的被困在阴阳庙里头了。
但怎会如此？
他们虽然一直都没能突破到阴阳庙的尽头，但这么多次的尝试，早已经熟悉了阴阳庙的规则权柄，即便没什么成果，脱身却不难。
更不要说，那可是叶蓁，实力极为强大，几乎不可能被困住才是。
“三叔，还请你去看看！”夏侯徳站起身来，对坐在角落里的另一个中年人行礼道。
夏侯牧，夏侯徳的三叔，实力极为恐怖，在他们这一辈属于绝对的强者，比之夏侯徳的父亲，都有过之无不及。
夏侯牧这次被派遣进入千神洞府，还是夏侯厌亲自做的决定。
旨在更好的帮助夏侯徳取得进展。
“嗯”，夏侯牧微微颔首，人则直接消失在原地。
夏侯牧亲自出面，势必要寻到叶蓁的下落。
大约过了半个时辰，阴阳庙的大门光幕之上，一道涟漪急速散开，随即，便是一道身影从中冲了出来。
是夏侯牧。
而他手中还提着一个人。
这人便是与夏侯家合作，能够驾驭强大阴阳之力的存在。
叶蓁不会始终等着林辰，也不会将宝压在林辰一人身上，虽说她又被林辰征服的感觉，对林辰也是另眼相待，但她这样的女人，可不是情绪一上来就丢掉脑子的。
家族的利益才是第一位。
content_en:
"Trapped?" Xia Houying exclaimed.
Ye Zhen is currently going deep into the Yin-Yang Temple, but this is not the first time. Regardless of past experiences, Ye Zhen has already entered the Yin-Yang Temple five times during this exploration of Thousand Gods Cave alone.
Although I have never been able to break through the Yin Yang Temple these few times, I have become very familiar with self-protection, and there has never been an accident.
But Xiahou Kui can't go wrong.
Xia Houying's face suddenly became tense and she couldn't help but worry.
Ye Zhen was not a good wife, and her reputation outside was not good, but she gave her all to their sisters.
"Go find daddy!" Xia Houying rushed out.
At this moment, outside the Yin-Yang Temple, where the Xiahou family was stationed, gentlemen were coming and going in a hurry.
Qian Shen Cave Mansion is the territory of the Xiahou family. The Xiahou family has been operating here for a long time, and its background is naturally not comparable to that of other forces.
In this exploration, the Xiahou family's target is of course not just the God's Name Core Crystal behind the Yin Yang Temple. At the same time, strong men have been dispatched throughout the Thousand Gods Cave to seize the fortune of each sect.
If everything goes well, the benefits to the Xiahou family will be unimaginable.
The sum of the rest of the people is probably comparable to that of the Xiahou family.
The Xiahou family is blooming more, and naturally the pressure is not less. At this moment, Xiahou De is taking command and coordinating all parties. He has a lot of things to deal with and is extremely busy.
"Dad, Mom is trapped, what's going on?" Xia Houying barged in directly.
And her words made Xiahou De and other senior officials of the Xiahou family stunned.
Xiahou De, sitting in the middle, has a majestic look on his face. He looks like the stereotypical head of a big family. Sitting there, he looks calm and dignified.
Xiahou De frowned and asked, "Ying'er, what's going on? What are you talking about?"
Even Xiahou De had not received any news that Ye Zhen was trapped.
"Sister said, mom is trapped!" Xia Houying said quickly.
Xia Houkui said.
Regarding this, all the strong men of the Xiahou family were shocked.
Xia Houkui should not be wrong, which means that Ye Zhen is really trapped in the Yin Yang Temple.
But how?
Although they have never been able to break through to the end of the Yin-Yang Temple, they have already become familiar with the rules and authority of the Yin-Yang Temple after so many attempts. Even if they have no results, it is not difficult to escape.
Not to mention, that was Ye Zhen, who was extremely powerful and almost impossible to be trapped.
"Third uncle, please go take a look!" Xiahou De stood up and saluted another middle-aged man sitting in the corner.
Xiahou Mu, Xiahou De's third uncle, was extremely powerful. He was an absolute strong man in their generation, even worse than Xiahou De's father.
It was Xia Houyan's personal decision to send Xiahou Mu into the Thousand Gods Cave this time.
Aiming to better help Xiahou De make progress.
"Yeah", Xia Houmu nodded slightly, and the person disappeared directly on the spot.
Xia Homu came forward in person and was bound to find Ye Zhen's whereabouts.
About half an hour later, a ripple spread rapidly above the light curtain at the gate of Yin Yang Temple, and then a figure rushed out.
It's Xia Homu.
And he was holding a person in his hand.
This person is a being who cooperates with the Xiahou family and can control the powerful power of yin and yang.
Ye Zhen will not always wait for Lin Chen, nor will she put her treasure on Lin Chen alone. Although she feels conquered by Lin Chen and treats Lin Chen differently, a woman like her does not lose her head as soon as her emotions arise.
The interests of the family come first.
title_en: Chapter 2420 Ye Zhen is trapped Chapter 2419 Heading to Yin Yang Temple
